events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Festival of Music & Art began on this day in 1969 in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Summer of Love vibes
angles.copy: 57 years ago today, the Woodstock Music & Art Fair kicked off. Three days of peace, love, and music that defined a generation. What was your favourite Woodstock moment?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The music world marks the anniversary of the passing of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who died in 1977.

angles.name: Long Live the King
angles.copy: On this day in 1977, we lost the King, Elvis Presley. His voice, his moves, his legacy – still unmatched. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: The music world remembers guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Guitar Hero Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled Jimi Hendrix, who left us on this day in 1970. His guitar changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' was released today in 1969. That album cover, those songs... pure genius. Which track is your favourite?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! The voice of The Pretenders, still rocking. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that unmistakable swagger to the stage. What's your top Oasis track?

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod, revolutionising portable music, on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: Music in your Pocket
angles.copy: Remember when the first iPod dropped? 25 years ago, Apple changed how we listened to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrate James Bond Day, marking the premiere of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred, naturally) to 007 and his incredible cinematic legacy. What's your favourite Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message still resonate deeply. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Ministry of Silly Walks
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedic genius. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The music world remembers Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: On this day in 1991, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain legendary. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: A Pivotal Album
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped today in 1965 – a true turning point in their sound. What's your favourite track from this classic?
